en: We are back up here in East Village.
zh: 我们又回到东村这边了。

en: It's home sweet home, guys.
zh: 这里真是我熟悉又温暖的家啊，大家。

en: This is where I lived for years.
zh: 我曾经在这里住了很多年。

en: We are here in Tompkins Square Park, and right behind us is Avenue A,
zh: 我们现在在汤普金斯广场公园，这条就在我们身后的就是A大道，

en: which is where our next location is.
zh: 我们的下一个地点就在那儿。

en: But we are going to Ray's Candy Store, where Anthony Bourdain also goes in his video.
zh: 不过我们现在要先去Ray's Candy Store，安东尼·波登也在他的视频里去过那里。

en: Pretty cool. It was founded by a very, very awesome, cool guy named Ray Alvarez,
zh: 很酷吧。这家店是一个特别特别棒、特别酷的人创办的，他叫Ray Alvarez，

en: which is the name he took when he came to the US.
zh: 这是他来到美国后给自己取的名字。

en: So he's actually an Iranian immigrant.
zh: 所以他其实是一位伊朗移民。

en: He was in the Iranian Navy.
zh: 他以前在伊朗海军服役。

en: And this is crazy, I read this recently, but he jumped ship off of the Virginia coast,
zh: 而且这事很离谱，我是最近才读到的，他当年在弗吉尼亚海岸附近弃船逃离，

en: swam to shore, and then made it to the US with no money in his pocket,
zh: 游上岸之后，身上一分钱都没有，就这样来到了美国，

en: came up to New York, worked 16-hour days as a busboy in different restaurants,
zh: 后来又来到纽约，在不同的餐馆里当清理餐桌的服务生，每天工作16个小时，

en: opened up Ray's Candy Store in 1974.
zh: 1974年开了这家Ray's Candy Store。

en: with, I believe it was $33,000 that he'd saved up over the years.
zh: 我记得他开店用的钱，好像是这些年攒下来的3.3万美元。

en: Opened this up, and it's been open ever since then.
zh: 店一开起来，就一直营业到了今天。

en: He's now 93 years old.
zh: 他现在已经93岁了。

en: Also, Ray's almost closed down a couple times, once during the recession
zh: 另外，Ray's之前也差点关门过好几次，有一次是在经济衰退期间，

en: and during COVID, and the East Village community came together through a Kickstarter
zh: 还有一次是在新冠疫情期间，当时东村社区的人一起通过Kickstarter众筹，

en: and fundraisers and all that and saved Ray's several times.
zh: 再加上各种募款活动之类的，前前后后救了Ray's好几次。

en: So the community absolutely loves Ray's.
zh: 所以这个社区的人真的非常非常喜欢Ray's。

en: Everyone knows who he is.
zh: 这里每个人都知道他是谁。

en: I hope he's in there.
zh: 希望他今天在店里。

en: Let's go see. Hi, Ray.
zh: 我们进去看看吧。嗨，Ray。

en: How are you? I'm so glad you're here.
zh: 你好吗？真高兴你在这儿。

en: This is... Hey, Ray.
zh: 这位就是……嘿，Ray。

en: This is Ray. Hello, America.
zh: 这位就是Ray。你好啊，美国。

en: Thank you, Ray. Thank you so much.
zh: 谢谢你，Ray。真的非常感谢。

en: I know you've been here in New York for a long time,
zh: 我知道你已经在纽约待了很多很多年，

en: and I know a little bit about your story getting here.
zh: 我也知道一点你是怎么来到这里的故事。

en: I wanted to ask what your favorite part about being in New York has been over the years.
zh: 我想问问，这些年来你最喜欢纽约的哪一点？

en: Oh, I love New York.
zh: 哦，我爱纽约。

en: New York is an international city.
zh: 纽约是一座国际化城市。

en: Absolutely. Everybody's speaking different language, and we all get along very well.
zh: 完全没错。每个人都说着不同的语言，但我们大家相处得都很好。

en: It's the best community.
zh: 这里的社区是最棒的。

en: And the job, available for everyone.
zh: 而且这里每个人都有工作机会。

en: And they hire you.
zh: 他们会雇用你。

en: I am one of them.
zh: 我自己就是其中之一。

en: Hire black, Jewish, Christian, Arab, Hindu.
zh: 黑人、犹太人、基督徒、阿拉伯人、印度教徒，他们都愿意雇用。

en: We have no bad feeling about anything.
zh: 我们对任何人、任何事都没有恶意。

en: Right. That's one of my favorite parts, too.
zh: 对，这也是我最喜欢的一点之一。

en: New York is very special.
zh: 纽约真的非常特别。

en: Well, you're such a staple in the community.
zh: 而你已经成了这个社区里非常有代表性的人物。

en: Everyone here loves coming to see you.
zh: 这里每个人都很喜欢来看你。

en: The community's good. It is.
zh: 这个社区很好，确实是。

en: Yeah, they help me a lot.
zh: 是啊，他们帮了我很多。

en: Well, thank you, Ray.
zh: 谢谢你，Ray。

en: I've loved coming here over the years.
zh: 这些年来我一直都很喜欢来这里。

en: and I love your story.
zh: 我也很喜欢你的故事。

en: Well, I couldn't have been more perfect.
zh: 再完美不过了。

en: Ray was there. He's not always, because sometimes at nighttime, he's a little sleepy.
zh: Ray今天正好在店里。他也不是每次都在，因为有时候到了晚上，他会有点犯困。

en: But during the day, it sounds like he's up and working at his age,
zh: 不过听起来白天的时候，以他这个年纪居然还是会起来工作，

en: which is crazy. Got a vanilla egg cream.
zh: 这真的太厉害了。我点了一杯香草蛋奶汽水。

en: First, not first reaction.
zh: 先说说，不算是第一口感受吧。

en: I've had a bunch of them before, but it's so good.
zh: 我以前喝过很多次了，真的很好喝。

en: I've had it like chocolate one before, and I didn't love it as much,
zh: 我之前喝过一次巧克力口味的，但没有那么喜欢，

en: but vanilla is delicious.
zh: 不过香草味真的很好喝。

en: It's like a vanilla milk with a little carbonation surprise.
zh: 它有点像香草牛奶，但又带着一点点碳酸那种惊喜感。

en: That's the best way to describe it.
zh: 我觉得这是最贴切的形容。

en: Excellent. Should we go to our next location?
zh: 太棒了。我们去下一个地点吗？

en: Let's do it.
zh: 走吧。
